jeskai-striker.path: Lower spell costs and improve spell payoffs.
jeskai-striker.limitation: Shiko and Narset reward the second spell each turn, not every spell.

rationale.support: Cost reducers, spell-damage payoffs and copied spells can share the same package.
rationale.payoff: The second spell can be copied if it targets a permanent or player; otherwise the commander draws a card.
rationale.constraints: Targeting only a spell or a graveyard card does not qualify for copying. The trigger occurs only on the second spell each turn.

avengers-assemble.path: Add Heroes that use counters and protect the attacking board.
avengers-assemble.limitation: Keeping Heroes narrows the pool; the commander supplies no card draw.

rationale.support: Additional Heroes can turn the entry counter into cards or stronger combat.
rationale.payoff: Haste immediately enables attack abilities on newly cast Heroes.
rationale.constraints: The deck still needs creatures and combat; ordinary strong creatures without the right type miss the bonus.

doom-prevails.path: Add repeatable connive and Villain payoffs.
doom-prevails.limitation: Doom’s land-discard reward triggers once per discard event, not once per land.

rationale.support: Connive engines and discard payoffs overlap with the Villain plan.
rationale.payoff: More discard events can trigger Doom again; discarding many lands together does not multiply that event.
rationale.constraints: Keeping Villains and enough lands constrains card choices; this grade does not assume switching to Loki.

the-fantastic-four.gap: The reviewed upgrade guide switches to Mister Fantastic. It cannot justify a grade for stock Invisible Woman.

continuity.retains: Keeps the noncreature-spell package and its triggered payoffs.
continuity.changes: Mister Fantastic draws cards and copies triggers; Invisible Woman makes Walls and rewards attacks.

alternatives.path: Keep the spell-trigger package and improve its ramp, interaction and payoffs.
alternatives.limitation: Copying a trigger requires four colours and tapping Mister Fantastic.

rationale.support: Noncreature interaction and ramp still enable the precombat draw condition.
rationale.payoff: The commander draws at combat after a noncreature spell and can copy one of your triggered abilities twice.
rationale.constraints: The copy ability needs four coloured mana and an untapped commander. It supplies no standalone damage finish.

wakanda-forever.path: Give the artifact half more card draw and recursion.
wakanda-forever.limitation: The artifact and monarch packages compete for slots.

rationale.support: Four-mana artifacts can supply draw, removal or recursion.
rationale.payoff: T’Challa’s mana helps deploy artifacts while its cast reward advances the board.
rationale.constraints: Support must fit the artifact mana-value restriction; the grade does not assume a different monarch commander.

tramplesaurus-rex.path: Add power-based ramp, card draw and board protection.
tramplesaurus-rex.limitation: Ghalta discounts its own casting cost but supplies no cards or protection.

rationale.support: Large creatures enable mana and draw engines as well as combat damage.
rationale.payoff: Existing board power reduces Ghalta’s generic cost.
rationale.constraints: Board wipes remove that discount’s support. More mana does not replace a lost hand.
